title: Nonlinear ARX Model
text: Simulate nonlinear ARX model in Simulink software, 1 input, 1 output; {Model} sets the nonlinear ARX model to be simulated idnlarx, {Initial conditions} sets the initial condition specification for simulation Input and output, {Input level} sets the steady-state input signal level, {Output level} sets the steady-state output signal level and {Specify initial states as a vector} sets the initial state values. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Model
params.values: Nonlinear ARX model to be simulated idnlarx object

params.name: Initial conditions
params.values: Initial condition specification for simulation Input and output values (default) | State values

params.name: Specify initial states as a vector
